title: Network partition between us-east and eu-west
summary: Cross-region connectivity loss. EU cluster cannot reach Kafka in us-east. Orders in eu-west failing.
rootCause: BGP route flapping in transit provider caused ~2min partition between regions.

aiAnalysis.summary: Network partition isolated eu-west from shared Kafka cluster in us-east.
aiAnalysis.rootCause: Transit provider BGP route flap caused temporary loss of connectivity between eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Kafka is single-region (us-east); EU orders depend on it for event publishing.
recommendations: Deploy regional Kafka clusters with replication across regions
Add circuit breakers for cross-region calls with fail-fast behavior
Consider event sourcing with regional write buffers
Add network partition drill to runbooks
